findings.description: The plan says to add --upgrade, --acknowledge, and --check-upstream to dontpanic_doctor argparse, but the public dontpanic doctor surface is parsed first by the console wrapper before delegating to dontpanic_doctor. If that wrapper is not explicitly updated, the user-facing command in the journey can reject the new flags or bypass the upgrade report path.
findings.recommendation: Pin wrapper updates and tests for the actual console path: cli.py _doctor_main argparse/help/delegation, plus real dontpanic doctor --upgrade, --upgrade --json, --upgrade --acknowledge, and --check-upstream invocations.

findings.description: The dashboard ActionItem spine uses exact_command and validates non-null commands against the command_validation vocabulary. F008 describes mapping upgrade items with a generic command field and only calls out source='upgrade' vocabulary extension, so the required-action drill-down can either lose the copyable command or fail validation for the canonical discover/backfill command surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Require upgrade ActionItems to populate exact_command with the first apply-labeled command, extend command_validation for projects discover/backfill-canonical and any doctor upgrade command used by items, and test the existing ActionItem constructor/render path.
